title: Monona Grove School District
body:
# Monona Grove School District

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/monona-logo.jpeg)

# Wisconsin

# Monona Grove School District

- **[Homepage](https://www.mononagrove.org/)** of the district website emphasizes that “equity is prioritized.” Equity means pushing for equal outcomes rather than equal opportunity.
- Monona **[claims](https://www.mononagrove.org/district/equity-at-mgsd)** students in their district have experience significant “structural racism and biases.”
- The **[district website](https://www.mononagrove.org/district/equity-at-mgsd/equity-resources)** links to “Equity Resources” promoting one of the middle school’s GSA’s. The GDS Gender & Sexuality Alliance (GSA). GDS is one of the district schools.
- The district website also links to “Families for Justice” - an organization that seeks to “dismantle white supremacy” and “white privilege.”
- Put out **[a video](https://www.mononagrove.org/academics-student-services/safe-schools-affirmation)** using students to promote “affirming allyship.”
